text.title: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) that pins the shape of a valid decision-record artefact for architecture-decision-records. Subagents validate against this before returning.

section.title: Schema (JSON Schema draft-07)
section.p: `alternatives_rejected` is minItems 2 because r3-alternatives-required says ≥2; the earlier minItems 1 contradicted the rule it was meant to encode. `consequences` is an object rather than a flat array so that r7-consequences-both-signs is machine-checkable. `supersedes` / `superseded_by` carry the r1-immutable-history chain in both directions; both are null on a first-of-its-kind ADR.

list.item: Updating an Accepted ADR's `status` to Deprecated or Superseded (and setting `superseded_by`) WITHOUT editing the body. r1-immutable-history freezes the argument, not the status field.
Backfilling an ADR for a pre-existing decision, when the rationale can still be reconstructed honestly. Mark `date` as the backfill date, not a fabricated original date.

example.note: Owner plural; status not in enum; alternatives_rejected empty.

forbidden.pattern: `alternatives_rejected` holds fewer than 2 entries — r3 is not satisfied by a single option.
`status: Accepted` AND `date` precedes any referenced commit date by < 1 hour — likely retroactive.
A body diff on an ADR whose `status` is already Accepted — r1 violation; supersede instead.

list.item: Every required field populated with a typed value — no empty strings, no empty lists.
No forbidden pattern above matches the output.
Allowed transformations applied where applicable, and nothing outside that list was mutated.
